parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a 2024 statute banning gender-reassignment medical interventions at all ages and barring any gender-marker change, with no recognition procedure since 2024. Whether the care ban reaches hormones, and whether visitor documents are checked, are unresolved. Hate-crime law exists on paper but is unenforced; police reactions are documented as homophobic, and 73% of victims in a 2012 survey did not report. Pride events were declared impossible by the interior ministry, and assemblies were repeatedly attacked with weak state protection. A trans actress-model was killed the day after passage, though one case in a country of unknown homicide rate carries limited weight alone. No offence of presentation is documented, and no organised sweeps against visitors appear. Overall this is a state-hostile climate with thin recourse and a likely care-access exposure, placing it in the High Risk band.
